title: Sim & Buff welcome you in
body: Red Hot Cod is a family-run seafood kitchen across the road from Burleigh Heads beach. Everything is wild-caught Australian and New Zealand seafood, cooked your way — beer-battered, grilled, crumbed or gluten-free — alongside a menu of Indonesian street food favourites.
alt: A bowl of nasi goreng topped with a fried egg, bean sprouts and cherry tomatoes
